title: Workshop Facilitator
summary: Run The Equal Lens sessions with kids — playful, purposeful, never preachy. You'll bring our games and scenarios to life in schools and community spaces.
responsibilities: Lead 60–90 minute interactive sessions for groups of children
Adapt activities to different ages and settings
Hold space for honest conversations about fairness with warmth
Share feedback that helps us improve the programs
requirements: Experience working with children (teaching, facilitation, youth work)
Comfortable improvising and keeping a room engaged
Believes in challenging ideas, never shaming the child
Available some weekdays and occasional weekends
